description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods—Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, ClnGS (w/), and ClnGS—on a task evaluated by a metric labeled “Average Performance,” which ranges from 0 to 60 on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the five methods in order from left to right. Each method is represented by a distinct colored bar: Standard (orange) at approximately 53, Self-RAG (beige) at about 54, FactTune (light green) at roughly 52, ClnGS (w/) (blue-gray) at around 54, and ClnGS (dark blue) at approximately 59. The bars are not sorted by performance, but ClnGS (dark blue) clearly outperforms the others, reaching the highest value near 59, while FactTune (light green) is the lowest at about 52. The chart includes horizontal dashed gridlines at intervals of 10 to aid in value estimation. The title or context “Paper: Context-Informed Grounding Supervision” suggests this chart is from a research paper evaluating grounding supervision techniques, with ClnGS (without the “w/” variant) demonstrating superior performance.
